title: v67 ABS P3a shell + SfA interface | TPEI + glue

plates.name: v67 ABS P3a shell + SfA interface | TPEI + glue

desc: Black ABS, version 67. Textured PEI with glue. Chin face down, 4 walls, blockers v3 (the settled boxes, the band along the chin edges and one cylinder in each post insert hole), 5 mm brim, tree supports in black ABS with the Support for ABS interface (D173), prime tower behind the part. Slice in the window. Filament 1 black ABS on the main (left) nozzle, filament 2 Support for ABS on the auxiliary (right) nozzle from its external spool (D178). Shrinkage: your calibrated preset on filament 1.
